messages.subject: Problem with predict command

I take the factor score for each person using this command

model.LRaxis.FactorScores <- predict(model.LRaxis.fit)[,1:3]

But when I try to compute the factor scores by hand, my results do not agree. I use this equation and I took the coefficients from the estimates above

dta$GVAction_fs <- dta$gincdif2 + 0.526 * dta$gvhlthc + 0.163 * dta$gvslvue

Can somebody please explain to me what I am doing wrong?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Problem with predict command
parts:
> I take the factor score for each person using this command
>
> model.LRaxis.FactorScores <- predict(model.LRaxis.fit)[,1:3]
>
> But when I try to compute the factor scores by hand, my results do not
> agree. I use this equation and I took the coefficients from the
> estimates above
>
> dta$GVAction_fs <- dta$gincdif2 + 0.526 * dta$gvhlthc + 0.163 * dta$gvslvue

I'm afraid your formula is wrong. There are several approaches to
calculate factor scores. lavaan uses the so-called 'empirical Bayes
approach' (also called the 'regression approach'). One source for the
formulas can be found in the technical appendices of Mplus, appendix 11:

www.statmodel.com/download/techappen.pdf

Yves.
